additional_info.subject: RE: ID0383864-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RD 300000004029] EVSE_TempLowerLimit CRM:00921001188
additional_info.body:
Hello Yunus,
Hope you are doing well.
Based on our analysis of the logs, there appear to be two or three possible reasons for triggering this error flag. We need to check the temperature on-site and verify the output of the BT2 sensor: 0V should correspond to -40ºC, and 10V should correspond to 80ºC.
1.
A faulty temperature sensor. Make sure to arrange a spare BT2 sensor while going on site to troubleshoot.
2. A loose connection to the BT2 sensor, causing it to sense faulty values.
Please troubleshoot the followings steps that are mentioned below-
3. A mismatch in wiring related to the temperature and humidity wires. This we can troubleshoot when we are on site.
To troubleshoot and narrow down the root cause, we have enabled Debug mode for this charger. If possible, please arrange for an EV to get charged, so that we can check the temperature and humidity values of the individual BT sensors and see if the values are swapped.
BT2 analog humidity sensor (DC Area) (0-10V equals 0% to 100% relative humidity)
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
